text:
Maria: FYI opened docs PR #824 — updates SDK snippets for streaming + retries + cursor pagination across Python / TypeScript / Go. Need quick sync and volunteers to run snippet CI.
Jeff: can you paste the PR link and a short summary of the breaking changes?
Maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/824 — summary: cursor param renamed to `cursor_id`, streaming now yields objects (e.g. `{ chunk: string }`) not raw strings, and retry helpers changed to `exponential_jitter` style. Also tightened examples to use the unified client API.
Lucy: @Maria :eyes: I'll take the TS snippets — will validate streaming + event -> async iterator mapping.
Samir: I'll pick up the Go examples and run the snippet smoketests. Heads-up: Go example currently misses `defer stream.Close()` in the example, that'll fail.
Lucy: quick TS note — we should prefer this pattern for streaming:
```ts
const stream = client.streamChat({ model: 'x', input });
for await (const ev of stream) {
  if (ev.type === 'data') console.log(ev.chunk);
}
```
Also will add a small `streamToAsyncIterator` helper in the snippets folder.
Maria: thanks. For Python the recommended pattern in the PR is:
```py
with client.stream_chat(model="x", input=prompt) as s:
    for part in s:
        print(part["chunk"])
```
That replaces the older raw-string stream example.
Samir: Go snippet to show retry + pagination (rough):
```go
retry := retrypkg.ExponentialJitter(100*time.Millisecond, 2.0, 1*time.Second)
stream, err := client.StreamChat(ctx, opts, WithRetry(retry))
defer stream.Close()
for stream.Next() {
  fmt.Println(stream.Chunk())
}
```
I'll push a small fix to the PR for the `defer` and the `Cursor` struct rename.
Jeff: also please add a top-line migration note in the SDK docs: "If you used raw string streaming or `cursor`, see migration guide". People will hit this when upgrading.
Lucy: will add README entry + changelog link. I'll also run `npm run docs:snippets` to generate the snippet snapshots and lint code fences.
Samir: running `make snippets-test` locally now. If CI fails for Go/py I'll post logs here.
Maria: can we include one short example showing pagination loop (language-agnostic)? maybe a pseudo-code block so it's clear how `cursor_id` flows.
Lucy: good idea — I'll add a small pseudo snippet in the migration section.
Jeff: minor editorial ask — ensure code fences specify the language (```python / ```ts / ```go), helps syntax highlighter.
Maria: agreed. Also adding a small note to highlight that retry semantics changed (exponential + jitter) — will include sample parameters.
Samir: found one more thing: the Go client method name changed from `ListPages` -> `ListWithCursor`. I'll update the snippet accordingly in the PR.
Maria: timeline: aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. Anyone blocked?
Jeff: not blocked — will review TS tonight.
Lucy: not blocked, will open a small follow-up PR if I need to split TS fixes.
Samir: doing tests now, will post results in ~15m.
docs-bot: snippets CI queued for PR #824 — will post status.
Maria: great, thanks everyone — once tests pass I'll squash and merge. (thumbsup)
